article.story: KINGSTON, R.I. -- — Jonah Hinton had 21 points in Rhode Island’s 79-72 win against Princeton on Sunday. Hinton had six rebounds for the Rams (5-0). Jahmere Tripp scored 18 points, shooting 4 of 8 from the field and 10 for 13 from the line. Matas Deniusas shot 2 of 5 from the field and 8 for 9 from the line to finish with 12 points. Jackson Hicke led the Tigers (3-2) in scoring, finishing with 32 points, six rebounds, four assists and two steals. Princeton also got 16 points from Dalen Davis. Rhode Island entered halftime up 27-24. Hinton paced the team in scoring in the first half with 10 points. Tripp scored 16 points in the second half. Up next Both teams play on Friday. Rhode Island plays Liberty and Princeton hosts Monmouth. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
